map.机油寿命受里程与存放时间双重影响。设置保养周期(如 5000km/6 个月)，记: Oil life is affected by both mileage and storage time. Set a service interval (such as 5000 km / 6 months) and record the last change, and the tool counts down locally to the next oil change. Data stays in the browser.
map.按里程或时间设周期: Set the cycle by mileage or time
map.倒计时提醒下次保养: Countdown reminder for the next service
map.私家车主保养提醒: Maintenance Reminder for Private Car Owners
map.新手记住首保时间: Beginners remember the first service interval
map.记录上次更换里程或日期: Record the mileage or date of the last change
map.全合成机油周期更长(约 1 万 km/年): Fully synthetic oil has a longer interval (about 10,000 km per year)
map.长期短途/拥堵应提前: Change early for long short trips or congested conditions
map.数据存本地，清缓存会丢失: Data is stored locally and is lost if the cache is cleared
map.以先到者为准，长期不开也要按时间换(机油会氧化)。: First come first served; even if the car is not driven it must be changed on schedule since oil oxidizes.
map.周期 5000km/6 月，已跑 3000km，则剩 2000km 或剩余月数先: Cycle 5000 km / 6 months with 3000 km already run, so 2000 km remain and whichever of the remaining distance or months comes first triggers the reminder.
